d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with thick, sweeping bangs that partially cover the face. A single visible crimson eye with a sharp, focused expression and a black eye patch over the other eye, set on a face with a youthful, adolescent maturity. A slender build wearing a tight-fitting black bodysuit with gold metallic piping and red honeycomb-textured accents on the chest, complemented by black and gold armored gauntlets. Signature details include large, curved black and red demonic horns protruding from the head and a long, thick white tail.
